canonical_state_ownership.decision: Backend owns canonical AI2 run lifecycle, durable state and audit; AI2 owns adaptation and bounded processing only.
canonical_state_ownership.guardrail: AI1 raw snapshots remain immutable and AI2 does not become the publish authority.

phase_1_reviewer_policy.decision: Only an explicitly authorized reviewer may apply a review command; no automatic approval.
phase_1_reviewer_policy.guardrail: Commands remain tenant-scoped and require a server-side state/version check.

checkpoint_expiration.decision: Expiration is terminal for the current generation; reopening creates a new generation and never auto-approves.
checkpoint_expiration.guardrail: The concrete TTL is tenant configuration and must be approved before production rollout.

auth_and_tenant_boundary.decision: Backend supplies the authenticated tenant, actor and scope; every read, replay and mutation is fail-closed outside that scope.
auth_and_tenant_boundary.guardrail: AI2 does not infer authorization from user text, document names or model output.

event_snapshot_audit_retention.decision: Raw evidence is immutable; canonical events and audit entries are append-only; replay uses durable events with snapshot fallback.
event_snapshot_audit_retention.guardrail: Retention periods and deletion/legal-hold values remain deployment policy, not an AI1 contract change.

live_transport.decision: Use authenticated HTTP commands plus SSE notifications/replay for the first live-review path.
live_transport.guardrail: SSE is not durable state or a command channel; WebSocket requires a later workload decision and rollback path.

review_ui_protocol.decision: Phase 1 uses fixed allowlisted review components with an AG-UI mapping boundary; A2UI is disabled by default.
review_ui_protocol.guardrail: The server validates commands and catalog/actions; the client never grants authority.

agent_boundary.decision: A2A is deferred and must not be introduced on the existing AI1 to AI2 processing path.
agent_boundary.guardrail: An A2A adapter requires an explicit independent-agent use case, authentication and contract decision.

compatibility_inputs.behavior: accept as degraded text-only evidence; preserve missing geometry/table evidence as review issues
compatibility lane only; never reinterpret as canonical snapshot

contract.logical_documents: one processing request may carry multiple snapshots; relations must be explicit

contract_cases.expected: canonical ai1.snapshot.v1 parses without changing source identity
legacy ocr.json stays degraded and records LEGACY_TEXT_ONLY
missing citation is rejected before SUCCEEDED/PASS
body and annex remain distinct source files with explicit relation
unsupported ai1.snapshot version is rejected deterministically
same scoped submission returns the same job; changed payload is rejected

rollback: retain the existing adapter and public schemas; remove this baseline artifact only with an explicit plan revision
notes: This artifact freezes compatibility and safety decisions for P0; it does not claim production TTL, retention or transport SLO values.
No AI1 producer, raw snapshot field or public processing schema was changed.
